clips.title: The story
paras: Heeding the Call marks a novice druid's summoning to Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff for advanced personal instruction. Relayed by innkeepers and kin across Horde settlements, the summons directs aspiring shapeshifters to Turak Runetotem. This meeting sets off the sacred trials required to master the form and spirit of the bear.

Word travels quickly across the plains of Mulgore and through the dusty thoroughfares of Orgrimmar. Whether heard from Innkeeper Gryshka among the orcs, Innkeeper Pala in Thunder Bluff, or Gennia Runetotem in Bloodhoof Village, the message is the same: Turak Runetotem has noticed your early progress. The Cenarion Circle does not summon practitioners lightly, and this invitation signals that your days of elementary herb-gathering and basic spellweaving have earned you deeper communion with nature's wild spirits.

Turak Runetotem serves as an assistant to Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem, guiding young tauren toward their ancestral duty inside the large Cenarion tent on Elder Rise. Welcoming initiates into a broader understanding of Cenarius's legacy, Turak instructs them that animals and plants are both allies and solemn charges. Meeting him is the opening threshold of the rite: stepping beyond basic mentorship to confront the trials of body and heart required to commune directly with the Great Bear Spirit.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It has come to my attention that Turak Runetotem has put out word that he wishes to speak with you. It seems that your training as a druid is about to take on a new life, and he will be training you personally. Turak is one of the Arch Druid's assistants; he is known as a wise and patient druid, and he should teach you well.
He is located in Thunder Bluff, inside the Cenarion Circle's main tent on the Elder Rise.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am glad you found your way here today, young druid. The time has come for you to take a large step into a much larger world.

Inside each of Cenarius' children is the call to serve nature. Animals and plants are our friends as well as our charges. We choose to devote our lives as preservers of balance for their sakes as well as our own. Your first step into this world will be to learn of the ways of the bear, and to learn strength of body and heart.
